up11:1.1: Thus the tree and the lord, and the lord and the tree
up11:1.2: With each other quarrel, and each other destroy.
up11:2.1: So it is with men, wherever a quarrel starts,
up11:2.2: They dance the peacock dance, like the lord and the tree.
up11:3.1: I say this to you, hearken, all assembled here,
up11:3.2: Be friendly, don't quarrel, be not like lord and tree,
up11:4.1: Train in peace, this is praised by the Awakened Ones,
up11:4.2: Delight in peace, righteousness, safety will not be destroyed.
